candidates.description_summary: Terraced two-bay, two-storey house over raised basement, built c.1832; part of a terrace of seven. Retains a historic three-bay rear return, round-headed doorcase with Ionic columns, granite entrance platform and original cast-iron coal-hole cover marked Hammond Lane Foundry Dublin.
candidates.appraisal_summary: NIAH describes this as the bookend of a largely intact early-to-mid nineteenth-century terrace and notes its unusual round-headed doorcase and retained residential use.
